import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Handle missing values in 'Income' by dropping rows, as income is crucial for this visualization
df.dropna(subset=['Income'], inplace=True)

# Define product spending columns
spending_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col.startswith('Mnt')]

# Calculate total spending for each customer
df['Total_Spending'] = df[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)

# Filter out extreme outliers in Income for better visualization of the main data cluster.
# The max income (666666) is an extreme outlier that skews the plot.
# We'll filter for incomes below a reasonable threshold, e.g., 200,000.
df_filtered = df[df['Income'] < 200000].copy()

# Create the scatter plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df_filtered,
    x='Income',
    y='Total_Spending',
    hue='Education',
    alpha=0.7,
    s=70,  # Adjust marker size for better visibility
    palette='viridis' # Choose a color palette
)

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Total Spending vs. Income, Grouped by Education Level', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Income', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Spending Across All Products', fontsize=12)

# Improve legend placement
plt.legend(title='Education Level', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Add a grid for easier reading
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)

# Adjust layout to prevent labels from overlapping
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd

df_filtered = df[df['Income'] < 200000].copy()

# Create the scatter plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df_filtered,
    x='Income',
    y='Total_Spending',
    hue='Education',
    alpha=0.7,
    s=70,  # Adjust marker size for better visibility
    palette='viridis' # Choose a color palette
)

# Add title and labels

plt.xlabel('Income', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Spending Across All Products', fontsize=12)

# Improve legend placement
